xmldoc.short_description: Render a gallery of tessera generators.

description.p: Render a 3-by-3 gallery of representative tessera generators (Perlin, fBm, ridged, Worley, Voronoi, domain warp, Mandelbrot, Julia and reaction-diffusion) in a single figure and return its handle. Requires a graphics-capable session.

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.
